deals.structure: Multi-year GPU cloud capacity; Microsoft was CoreWeave's dominant early customer. CoreWeave's 10-Q anonymizes customers as A-D.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Concentration has fallen. The 10-Q shows 'Customer A' at 67% of Q3 2025 revenue and 24% of Q3 2026 revenue (33% of nine-month 2026). 'Customer B' was 30% of Q3 2026 revenue. Customers are not named in the filing; press attributed 71% of H1 2025 revenue to Microsoft.
deals.notes: Identification of Customer A as Microsoft is an inference, not stated in the filing excerpt we read.

deals.structure: Order form under an existing master services agreement; up to about $14.2B of cloud capacity through Dec 14, 2031, with an option to extend to 2032. Subject to delivery/availability requirements and termination rights.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: No expansion found in searches. Meta may be 'Customer B' in the 10-Q, but this is not stated.
deals.notes: Underlying 8-K summarized via a secondary site; fetch SEC original before publishing as 'verified'.

deals.structure: Contracts totaling about $22.4B after a $6.5B expansion in Sept 2025 (earlier contracts of about $11.9B and $4B).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: CoreWeave's Q3 2026 release lists OpenAI among expanded relationships; no new dollar figure confirmed.

deals.structure: Nvidia bought $2B of CoreWeave Class A stock at $87.20/share; CoreWeave targets 5+ GW by 2030. Company said cash is not for buying Nvidia chips.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Shares traded about $40-61 in Nov 2026, well below the $87.20 purchase price (price from press, not verified).
deals.notes: Nvidia is also a supplier and was reported to have committed up to about $6.3B to buy CoreWeave's unused capacity through 2032 (2025 arrangement; figure varies by report).

deals.structure: Nvidia agreed to purchase CoreWeave's unused cloud capacity through 2032 (up to about $6.3B).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Not updated in sources found.
deals.notes: Sources differ on exact amount ('up to $6.3B' vs 'more than $6B').

deals.structure: Five-year GPU infrastructure (GB300) contract; $17.4B base, up to about $19.4B with additional services.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Nebius RPO reportedly $38.7B at Q3 2026 (+3% q/q) despite $12B+ of new signings; power delays flagged by one analyst.
deals.notes: Fetch the Sept 2025 Nebius 6-K to upgrade to verified.

deals.structure: Five-year AI infrastructure agreement, about $3B.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Superseded in scale by the March 2026 agreement.

deals.structure: 'Second Meta Agreement' signed Mar 13, 2026: $12B dedicated capacity firm; Meta may buy more up to $15B further over five years (up to about $27B).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: New lead found; not in original lead list. $12B is firm, remainder is optional.
deals.notes: Description from search summary of SEC 6-K; verify the exhibit text.

deals.structure: Converts: Aug 2026 $3.45B 0.50% 2030 notes and $2.3B 4.50% 2034 notes ($5.75B); earlier $4.16B converts (2025). $3.5B secured facility with Citi (Oct 2026).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: n/a
deals.notes: Coupons/principal quoted from a Substack citing the 6-K.

deals.structure: Five-year GB300 GPU cloud contract, 20% prepayment, 200 MW IT across four 50 MW phases at Childress TX; about $1.94B annualized revenue at full run-rate.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Horizon 1 (50 MW) delivered Aug 2026; Horizons 2-4 expected later in 2026. $3.65B investment-grade financing closed June 2026.
deals.notes: 10-K also lists a separate ~$3.4B five-year cloud contract with Nvidia and ~$2.8B of July 2026 deals (Prometheus, Perplexity, Together AI), per search summary.

deals.structure: $2.1B private placement (fixed 5.96%) plus $1.55B delayed-draw term loan (SOFR+2.25%), secured by GPUs and the Microsoft contract; with Microsoft prepayments funds about 96% of $5.81B contract GPU capex.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: As of Sep 30, 2026: $413M of term loan drawn and $1,575M notes issued.
deals.notes: Debt alone is about 63% of capex ($3.65B/$5.81B); '96%' includes the prepayment. Useful loan-to-cost datapoint.

deals.structure: About 200,000 GB300 GPUs across Texas, Portugal, UK, Norway. Dollar value not disclosed by Nscale; press says up to $24B; other outlets cite $43.8B of Microsoft statements of work.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Oct 2026: Microsoft terminated the UK Loughton site (grid delay) and declined an option to expand Texas; Nscale says other contracts unaffected. IPO filing cites $103B contracted take-or-pay, with Microsoft and Anthropic about 85% of contract value.
deals.notes: Values conflict; dollar figures are not company-confirmed.

deals.structure: 'Multi-billion-dollar' GPU capacity agreement; value undisclosed.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: IPO reportedly targeted H2 2026; completion not confirmed.

deals.structure: Nvidia leases back about 18,000 GPUs from Lambda over four years (about $1.3B for 10,000 GPUs plus $200M for 8,000); Lambda funded purchases partly via a $917M Morgan Stanley-led leveraged loan.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: No update found.
deals.notes: Based on The Information/Bloomberg reporting.

deals.structure: Google backstops Fluidstack's lease obligations at Lake Mariner: $1.8B initially, raised to about $3.2B with the CB-5 expansion, in exchange for warrants (about 14% pro forma stake after expansion). Separate Abernathy JV: Google backs about $1.3B of Fluidstack lease obligations with no TeraWulf warrants.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Backstop raised from $1.8B to $3.2B; TeraWulf/Fluidstack JV planned $1.275B secured notes due 2030.
deals.notes: Company press releases exist at these links but we read only search summaries; warrant counts differ across secondary sources (41M vs 73.5M); check filings.

deals.structure: Google backstops $1.4B of Fluidstack lease obligations at Barber Lake TX; warrants for about 24M Cipher shares (about 5.4% pro forma). Further $333M backstop added for a 39 MW lease. Cipher sold $1.7B 7.125% notes (Nov 2025) plus $333M add-on.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Backstop grew by $333M; Cipher also financed an AWS-leased site ($2B 6.125% notes due 2031, Feb 2026), showing lower pricing when tenant is a hyperscaler directly.
deals.notes: Cipher 8-Ks on sec.gov are the primary documents.

deals.structure: Anthropic plans $50B of US data center investment starting with custom sites in Texas and New York, developed with Fluidstack; first sites 2026.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: No later financing structure found in searches.
deals.notes: Headline is a company-stated plan, not a contractual payment to Fluidstack; verified as a company statement only.

deals.structure: 15-year take-or-pay lease of all 400 MW at Polaris Forge 1 (ND), about $11B over base term. Macquarie committed up to $5B preferred equity for the campus program.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Macquarie draws of $112.5M, $562.5M, $337.5M reported; separate 200 MW Polaris Forge 2 lease with an investment-grade hyperscaler.
deals.notes: Core Scientific, Galaxy, Crusoe not verified; see dropped_leads/open_questions.

deals.from: Lenders (MUFG, Morgan Stanley, Goldman, JPMorgan; Blackstone anchor)
deals.structure: DDTL 4.0: non-recourse delayed-draw term loan, matures Mar 2032, rated A3 (Moody's) / A (low) DBRS; floating tranche SOFR+2.25%, fixed tranche about 5.9%; secured by assets of a CoreWeave SPV and an unnamed AI enterprise's cloud contract.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Later DDTL 5.0/5.5 for lower-rated customers priced at 4.50%/5.50% over SOFR (secondary source).
deals.notes: Press release gives no advance rate/LTV.

deals.structure: Q3 2026: $2.6B DDTL 5.5 facility (shorter-duration customer contracts) plus about $4.2B convertible senior notes; new ATM program for up to 35M shares.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: n/a
deals.notes: Convert coupon not captured.

deals.structure: GPU-collateralized DDTL 1.0 (2023, $2.3B, Magnetar/Blackstone) and DDTL 2.0 (2024, $7.5B, Blackstone/Magnetar led), secured by GPUs and customer contracts; spreads far above later facilities (about SOFR+9.6% 2023; 6.0-13.0% in 2024 depending on customer credit).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Pricing fell to SOFR+4.0% (DDTL 3.0, Jul 2025) and SOFR+2.25% (DDTL 4.0, 2026).
deals.notes: Dollar sizes of DDTL 1.0/2.0 are from memory and not confirmed in this pass; CoreWeave S-1 is the primary source.

deals.from: Blue Owl funds / bond investors (Pimco among buyers, per reports)
deals.structure: Beignet Investor LLC issued $27.3B 6.581% A+ senior secured amortizing bonds due 2049 (Morgan Stanley). JV owned about 80% Blue Owl funds / 20% Meta; Meta leases the campus and provides a residual value guarantee over the first 16 years of operations (reported max about $28B; no liability booked).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Wikipedia reports Meta raised planned Hyperion investment to over $50B in July 2026, so the bond covers part of the buildout.
deals.notes: Interpretations of how the guarantee works differ across sources; check Meta 10-K/10-Q and 144A materials. Accounting treatment is debated, not alleged improper.

deals.structure: SPV with $7.5B equity (Nvidia up to $2B) and $12.5B debt buys Nvidia GPUs and leases them to xAI for five years with purchase option; debt secured by the GPUs.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: No confirmation of final closing terms found.
deals.notes: Implied debt share 62.5% of SPV capital.

deals.structure: Construction debt in two packages ($23.25B and $14.75B) for Vantage campuses in Texas (Frontier) and Wisconsin, leased to Oracle for OpenAI.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Early 2026 reports of waning bank appetite and syndication to other investors; by May 2026 banks distributing and de-risking. Michigan (Saline Twp): Pimco reportedly anchored $10B of a record $16.3B bond after banks pulled back. Abilene: about $13B from Blue Owl/JPMorgan SPV ($10B debt).
deals.notes: Reports of $72B total partner debt vary; sources inconsistent on details.
